svg.text: regulator_5vPololu D36V50F5 5 V 5.5 A step-down regulator
Inline ATM mini blade fuse holder
Inline ATM mini blade fuse holder
Inline ATM mini blade fuse holder
Inline ATM mini blade fuse holder
Inline ATM mini blade fuse holder
Inline ATM mini blade fuse holder
Inline ATM mini blade fuse holder
VBAT 11.1 V from SW1: load 5.951 A typical, 14.951 A peak; source 35 A cont, 70 A peak; fuse 7.5 A
5V 5 V from U4: load 1 A typical, 5 A peak; source 5.5 A cont, 8 A peak
Fuses: F1 7.5 A (everything on VBAT), F2 2 A (branch regulator_5v), F3 2 A (branch actuator_bus), F4 2 A (branch fl_hip_abduction_actuator), F5 2 A (branch
fr_hip_abduction_actuator), F6 2 A (branch rl_hip_abduction_actuator), F7 2 A (branch rr_hip_abduction_actuator). Branch fuses sit inline in the lead they
Lever splices (actuator_bus_hub, star_ground, splice_vbat) are junctions of their nets.
Same net label or power symbol = same conductor. X = pin not connected.
